item.title: LogicGrid 11.2.1
item.description:
Fixes

  • 120 fps cursor tracking for Focus mode and the scrub line when the high refresh setting is on.
  • Grid lines and subdivisions near cycle regions now draw much more accurately, including edges on barlines, after toggling or moving the cycle, and after horizontal scrolling.
  • Fixed the grid freezing in a stale, slightly offset state after scrolling until the next zoom.
  • Logic Pro slowdown during long sessions: far fewer background queries to Logic.
  • LogicGrid no longer works at full speed when Logic Pro is closed.
  • Improved grid detection when Logic runs in a non English language.
  • Line opacity set to zero now sticks instead of resetting to default.
  • Scanning indicator dots now animate properly.
  • Welcome guide updated to cover all five grid modes.
